tudor/heritage-black-bay-79220b.summary: The first Heritage Black Bay: a 41 mm diver built on an ETA 2824-based movement.

sinn/556.summary: The 556 I: a plain 38.5 mm pilot-style watch with a date at 3 on an H-link bracelet, its ETA 2824-2 visible through the caseback.

hamilton/khaki-field-auto-h70455553.summary: A 38 mm field watch with the H-10, Hamilton's version of the 2824-derived ETA C07.611, slowed to 21,600 vph for 80 hours of reserve and visible through the caseback.

seiko/presage-srpb43.summary: A 40.5 mm dress watch with a pressed sunray dial and a tall box crystal, on Seiko's 4R35 — the NH35A under its own name — seen through the display back.

hamilton/ventura-xxl-auto-h24655331.summary: The XXL take on the 1957 Ventura's shield: a 45.5 x 46 mm stepped steel case, a black open dial whose grille shows the movement, and a pointed crown housing marking 3 o'clock. It runs the H-10, Hamilton's 80-hour version of the 2824-derived ETA C07.611, visible through a screwed-on display back.

sinn/103-st-sa.summary: A 41 mm pilot's chronograph with a 60-click countdown bezel, a high-domed sapphire and day and date at 3, on the Valjoux 7750 seen through the display back.
